claim_tested: Learned models generalise beyond random splits (USDA R6 retention)
data_version: DEL-2 baselines seed 7; USDA-RETN-R6 6,994 rows (2,620 censored) = 7,018 ACTIVE EVD rows minus 24 unknown-retention rows
metric: censor-aware MAE, fraction scale (D0 persistence, D4 nearest-compatible, D5 gradient boosting)
value: random: D5 0.0251 vs D0 0.1205; matrix_disjoint: D0 0.0590, D4 0.0567, D5 0.0692; process_disjoint: D0 0.0728, D5 0.0672, D4 0.0725
consequence: Cold-split collapse: the random-split gain disappears; on matrix- and process-disjoint splits no learned model is separable from persistence (CIs overlap). Random-split improvements must not be cited as generalisation.
